metrics_precision: float64 saved-data comparisons; original runtime float32 metrics remain unchanged
claim_limits: This analyzes existing saved tensors, not a new model run.
Current-call same-input error and prior-state effect are both measured; no individual operator root cause or full-trajectory fidelity follows.
Layer taps are endpoints within a call; earlier hidden errors propagate into later layers.
Other than logits, no historical full-replay QDQ output bundle exists at this position; own-QNN comparisons use the new controlled QDQ outputs.
Difference vectors add with recorded floating residual; scalar cosines and norms are not additive or attribution percentages.
Prior-state-effect interpretation assumes the fixed PTE/native runtime stack; physical/accuracy/campaign claims remain excluded.
